endScreen.title: Clarity Found

reality.name: The Placeholder
reality.description: Are we a destination or a stop?

questions.question: Do you ever purposefully wait to reply to my messages just to seem less interested than you actually are?
What is a part of yourself you suppress around me to keep things 'light'?
Do you feel relieved or anxious when we spend time together?
WILDCARD: Unlock your phone and show me your last 3 used emojis. Explain who they were sent to.
Do you assume I am seeing other people? Do you want to know the specific answer?
If I posted a romantic story with someone else tonight, would you feel you had the *right* to be upset?
Have you described me to your friends as 'just a friend' to protect yourself from questions?
WILDCARD: Describe your 'Plan B' person without mentioning their name.
Who holds the power in our dynamic right now—the one who cares less, or the one who asks for less?
If one of us catches real feelings, is this arrangement automatically over?
Are we avoiding the 'what are we' conversation because we don't know, or because we know the answer will end this?
WILDCARD: Staring Contest. Maintains eye contact for 30 seconds. The first to look away cares less.
Be honest: Am I a placeholder for the relationship you actually want, or am I the destination?
When this ends, what single sentence will you use to explain why it didn't work to your friends?
If you met your 'dream person' tomorrow, would you drop me immediately?
WILDCARD: Ask me the one question you've been too afraid to ask because it might 'ruin' this.
